lessons.title: 1. What is an API?
lessons.explanationHtml:
Concept Overview

  • Designing robust APIs using What is an API?.

Real-World Analogy

  • A waiter taking orders from customers (Frontend) and delivering requested meals from the kitchen (Backend).

Industry Application

  • Powering mobile apps, single-page web apps, and third-party integrations.

Common Pitfalls & Fixes

  • Returning HTTP 200 OK status when a server error actually occurred.

Practice Exercise

title: System Design Basics
description: Master Scalability, Load Balancers, Caching, and Microservices step-by-step with simple English and bullet points across 25 lessons.

lessons.title: 1. What is System Design?
lessons.explanationHtml:
Concept Overview

  • Architecting scalable systems with What is System Design?.

Real-World Analogy

  • Designing a mega-highway network with multiple toll booths, detours, and speed lanes to handle 1 million cars smoothly.

Industry Application

  • Building web platforms capable of handling millions of active concurrent users.

Common Pitfalls & Fixes

  • Adding complex microservices before validating basic monolithic MVP requirements.

Practice Exercise

  • Sketch a architecture block diagram utilizing What is System Design?.
